verdict.summary: Rice-nachos can be at risk for gluten contamination due to cross-contact with gluten-containing ingredients or shared cooking equipment. Careful preparation methods are essential to ensure safety for individuals with coeliac disease.

disclaimer: This guidance is informational only. Always verify ingredients and preparation with the restaurant.
